Question Choices: Write the ordered pair for a point that is 2 units right and 9 units up of the origin. (__, __)
Hints: Start at the origin. Read horizontal x first, then vertical y.
Solution: From the origin move 2 units right along x and 9 units up along y. Ordered pairs put horizontal before vertical, so the point is(2,9).
